task_contract.action_rule: action must match a registered worker capability or be a controlled report/plan/route action
task_contract.dependency_rule: depends_on must reference tasks in the same project and every dependency must be completed before a dependent task can run
task_contract.safety_rule: restricted actions remain blocked without owner approval and enabled external integration
